description: Inspect an editable .mcpx source or raster image without writing: structure reports layers, regions, color usage, and overlaps; view returns the composited PNG plus metadata. Raster inputs read as a single base layer.

crop.description: View-only selection expression (atom string or JSON expression object) naming the crop; an empty match refuses with EMPTY_SELECTION.

inputPath.description: Editable .mcpx source or raster image path to inspect; raster inputs read as a single base layer. Never written.

mode.description: Inspect mode: structure for layers, regions, color usage, and overlaps; view for the composited PNG plus metadata.

scale.description: View-only integer upscale factor 1-16 with nearest sampling; omitted means 1.

name: inspect_asset
